_meta.owner: location-engineer (values copied from level-designer / product-manager documents)
_meta._note: Analysis-only parameters (not read by the game runtime). launch-criteria.md section 3 asks for the Launch Score weights to live here instead of in code. Walk-graph snap limit and route factors are read from config/balance/dungeons.json#coverageFilter, never from this file.

_source.distanceBands_m: product/prd/F01-coverage-survey.md section 3 (green <= 800 m, yellow 800-3,000 m, red > 3,000 m)
_source.footOverrideValues: A-P1-F01-T06-2: a way with access in coverageFilter.excludeAccessValues stays walkable when foot is one of these (pedestrian streets are often access=no + foot=yes)
_source.transit: design/levels/launch-criteria.md section 4.3 (rail 2 : bus 1, parking not scored) · D-069: transitDistance = min(bus, (2 x rail + bus) / 3) when rail is within railAcceptableWalk_m, else bus
_source.transit.railAcceptableWalk_m: A-P1-F01-T06-3: launch-criteria 4.3 says 'rail within an acceptable distance' without a number; the PRD green band (800 m) is used. Owner: level-designer
_source.circuityMinStraight_m: run-meta only: measured route factor (network / straight line to the same dungeon) uses cells at least this far in a straight line, so tiny denominators do not dominate
_source.graphBboxBuffer_m: walk graph covers the study-area bounding box plus this margin so routes near the edge may leave the study area
_source.populationResolutionLabel: PRD F01 section 8.2 asks for the resolution per area; WorldPop is one grid for the whole country
_source.presets: data/dungeons/presets.json presets[].matches (class first, then size_band; level-designer P1-F03-T09)
_source.launchDistricts: D-083 (HUMAN 2026-09-25): launch districts เขตพระนคร 92053 + เขตปทุมวัน 92063 + เขตบางรัก 92061 (district_osm_id); used only by python -m analysis.compare
_source.goCriteria: product/prd/F01-coverage-survey.md section 4.1 G1-G4, copied for the before/after table only (python -m analysis.compare); the PRD stays the source
_source.f11PresetId: D-069 criterion F-11: a launch district needs a pocketPark within unlocks.home.farDungeonThreshold_m of homes; district-counts.csv column pocketPark_walk_median_m = population-weighted median network walk distance from populated cells to the nearest usable dungeon of this preset anywhere in the study area (P2-F04-T03)
_source.heatmap: display only: population is aggregated to blocks of displayBlockCells x displayBlockCells source cells before drawing (no single 100 m cell is shown)

populationResolutionLabel: WorldPop R2025A constrained, 3 arc-second grid (about 100 m), same resolution in all 79 districts
